name: Quality Inspection-custom_roll_ticket
label: Roll Ticket
description: Auto-linked Roll Ticket. Set at QI creation time for fast lookup.

name: Quality Inspection-custom_desar_grade_readings
label: DESAR Grade Readings
description: Dynamic grade count readings. Auto-populated from DESAR Grade Configuration when QI is created. One row per grade.

name: Quality Inspection-custom_desar_stage_name
label: DESAR Stage Name
description: Stage name from Design Master Stage Configuration. Set at QI creation time.

name: Quality Inspection-custom_desar_grade_adj_section
label: Grade Adjustments During Packing
description: Fill when grades change during packing operations. Mandatory when Final QI grade counts differ from Finishing QI. Upgrades: B→A. Downgrades: A→B, A→C.

name: Quality Inspection-custom_desar_grade_adjustments
label: Grade Adjustments
description: Record each grade movement during packing. Example: 3 pieces upgraded from B to A after ironing.
